messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: elevated error rate and token latency observed for model variant `gamma` (llama-v4-gamma) in eu-west-1. 5xx spike started ~08:52 UTC, p50 latency ↑ 3x. Error budget burn: 73% in last 15m. Paging oncall.

sara (oncall): I'm on it. @jamal @mina can you triage? Is this a perf regression or infra flake? Any customer-facing errors? :eyes:

jamal (eng-sre): looking at infra metrics now. Node pool for gamma shows increased alloc failures and OOMs on a subset of GPUs. Logs show repeated `KVCache eviction` bursts and host-level mem pressure. Not seeing obvious network flaps. Tentative hypothesis: model variant memory profile changed, causing runaway cache behavior under live traffic pattern.

mina (eng-ml): thanks. We rolled a quantization tweak in gamma yesterday for perf; could be a regression with large context windows. Quick mitigation: shift traffic off gamma to stable `v3-stable` and disable gamma routing. We can also trigger emergency quotas for keys hammering the system.

sara (oncall): agree. Priorities: 1) Stop more traffic hitting gamma, 2) Ensure customers get degraded but stable responses, 3) Minimize blast radius. Jamal, can you run the traffic-shaping commands? I'll notify support and product.

jamal (eng-sre): running controlled demotion now. Plan:
- Set variant weight gamma -> 0 for eu-west-1
- Reroute to v3-stable and v3-quant-fallback with 100% fallback split
- Apply emergency per-key QPS caps for top 50 heavy keys

Commands I'm using:
```bash
# demote gamma in eu-west-1
redwoodctl routing set-weight --model llama-v4 --variant gamma --region eu-west-1 --weight 0

# pin traffic to v3-stable fallback
redwoodctl routing set-weight --model llama-v4 --variant v3-stable --region eu-west-1 --weight 100

# apply emergency per-key QPS (quick patch)
redwoodctl quotas set --scope keys --top 50 --qps 2 --duration 30m --reason "emergency mitigation: gamma mem pressure"
```
I'll stream logs here as they happen.

deploy-bot: action=route-update request_id=cb9f4e. Started routing mutation. Previous weights: gamma=60, v3-stable=40. Target weights: gamma=0, v3-stable=100. ETA ~15s for controlled rollout.

jamal (eng-sre): route mutation applied. Confirming proxy configs reloaded and traffic draining lambda initiated for gamma in eu-west-1.

deploy-bot: action=route-update request_id=cb9f4e status=success. All edge proxies report new weights.

mina (eng-ml): ✅ traffic shift confirmed. Telemetry shows gamma request rate -> ~0 within 30s. v3-stable qps increased accordingly. Watching quality metrics for regressions.

sara (oncall): applying emergency quotas now as well. Jamal can you list top keys so we can message affected customers? Also attach a short note for status page.

jamal (eng-sre): top keys by qps in last 10m: key_8a3, key_5f1, key_22b, key_9d0... pushing list to #support-customer-notifications. I applied the per-key QPS cap; system shows reduced sustained load. CLI snippet for audit:
```bash
redwoodctl quotas get --recent --top 50 --output json | jq .
```

elaine (support): thanks. I'll draft a customer-facing message: short outage note, mention degraded performance for some high-throughput customers, and say we rolled traffic to stable model variant and are investigating. Posting to status.redwood.ai in <15m unless you want to wait.

ryan (cust-success): pls @me before posting to ensure we include the list of customers on elevated throttles. I'll ping the three enterprise keys.

kevin (product): re: rollout — good call. We should also disable the gamma progressive rollout for other regions until root cause known. Mina, can you start a quick bisect against yesterday's quantization commit? Put findings in the incident ticket.

mina (eng-ml): starting bisect on the quantization revert. If gamma's memory profile changed due to kernel selection, we might see it locally. I'll try a repro with long-context traces used by top keys. Will post artifacts to the incident JIRA: INF-3391.

sara (oncall): status so far — oncall engaged, gamma traffic set to 0 in eu-west-1, emergency per-key QPS caps applied, customers informed draft pending. Any customer impact metrics?

mina (eng-ml): early quality checks: v3-stable latency p50 ~ expected baseline, error rate reverted to normal. No immediate correctness regressions for a sampled set of prompts but will run full evals.

jamal (eng-sre): infra health checks: node mem pressure cleared after draining gamma. No other variants affected. We're keeping gamma nodes quarantined for now.

deploy-bot: action=variant-disable request_id=8a11bb status=in-progress. Disabling automatic autoscale for gamma to prevent reallocation.

sara (oncall): great. Next steps: Mina to continue bisect, Jamal to keep gamma quarantined and gather logs, Elaine + Ryan to contact impacted customers, Kevin to update exec and decide about rollback for other regions. I'll keep this channel for live updates. If anything changes, call page.

jamal (eng-sre): uploaded diagnostic bundle: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2105004321/diagnostics.tar.gz. Contains kernel traces, dmesg, container oom logs, and deployment diff. Key note: repeated memcpy spikes before OOM.

mina (eng-ml): bisect found likely culprit: commit 45c7f9 introduced a kernel preference that changes KV cache allocation for sequence lengths > 8192. Reverting that patch in a canary reproduces low mem pressure. Filing PR to revert.

kevin (product): recommend we leave gamma disabled globally until revert validated. Approving cross-region freeze. @sara please enact global safe-mode for llama-v4 gamma.

sara (oncall): enacting global freeze. Command:
```bash
redwoodctl variant set-state --model llama-v4 --variant gamma --state disabled --reason "emergency: mem regression"
```

deploy-bot: action=variant-disable request_id=8a11bb status=success. Variant `gamma` marked disabled globally.

elaine (support): posting status update now: "We have temporarily disabled model variant `llama-v4-gamma` after elevated errors and latency. Traffic has been routed to `v3-stable`. We're investigating root cause and will provide updates every 30m."

ryan (cust-success): notified top impacted customers and offered rate-adjusted replacement keys + guidance on using v3-stable. One customer asked for ETA; I said we'll know more after the revert PR verification (1-2 hours estimate).

sara (oncall): current verdict: mitigation successful — gamma disabled, traffic stable on fallbacks, error budget receding. Incident severity downgraded to Sev3 for monitoring and follow-up. We'll run postmortem after fix is deployed. Good job team. :clap:

mina (eng-ml): opening PR revert: https://git.redwood.ai/rl/llama/merge_requests/1223 — running CI and perf tests. If green, we'll schedule a controlled deploy to canary with long-context workload.

jamal (eng-sre): retaining quarantine nodes for 2h to collect extended telemetry. If no regressions, we can reprovision nodes later.

sara (oncall): closing live mitigation phase. Keep this thread for follow-ups. Last note: attach incident timeline and list of keys that saw throttles to INF-3391. Ending handoff to oncall rotation for monitoring.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: gamma disabled globally, traffic rerouted to v3-stable at 09:15 UTC. Current error budget: 12% (improving). Incident ticket: INF-3391.
